purpose: Executable governance manifest for promoting RAFAELIA seeds from semantic catalog to real-use fullstack modules without hiding failures.

work_modes.title: Invariant first
work_modes.purpose: Start every promotion from fixed invariants.
work_modes.acceptance: A test or check fails if an invariant changes.
work_modes.rollback: Revert the manifest or block the promotion.
work_modes.failover: Keep the previous documented route active.
work_modes.falsification: ATTRACTOR_COUNT, period, or phi invariant is absent.

work_modes.title: Contract before code
work_modes.purpose: Define input, output, errors, and rollback before implementation.
work_modes.acceptance: The contract names validation and fallback.
work_modes.falsification: A module is implemented without a contract.

work_modes.title: Determinism by hash
work_modes.purpose: Compare fixed inputs by stable hash.
work_modes.acceptance: Repeated runs produce the same digest.
work_modes.rollback: Discard changed output until cause is explained.

work_modes.title: Empty token integrity
work_modes.purpose: Prefer SKIPPED over unsupported claims.
work_modes.acceptance: Unproven claims are marked as hypothesis or skipped.
work_modes.failover: Return a bounded clarification or empty-token note.
work_modes.falsification: A metaphor is presented as proven production behavior.

work_modes.title: Mandatory falsification
work_modes.purpose: Attach a failure condition to each theorem or module.
work_modes.acceptance: Negative case is documented.

work_modes.title: Feature flag promotion
work_modes.purpose: Ship new routes disabled or reversible.
work_modes.acceptance: Old route remains available.

work_modes.title: Layer rollback
work_modes.purpose: Define return path per documentation, CLI, app, native, and assembly layer.
work_modes.acceptance: Rollback text exists for each mode.
work_modes.failover: Route to the nearest stable layer.

work_modes.title: Explicit failover
work_modes.purpose: Keep a stable fallback when an optimized path fails.
work_modes.acceptance: Failover text exists and names target path.

work_modes.title: Execution watchdog
work_modes.purpose: Bound long loops and process waits.
work_modes.acceptance: Timeout or cycle budget is declared.
work_modes.falsification: Unbounded loop or wait is introduced.

work_modes.title: Fixed hot-path memory
work_modes.purpose: Avoid heap allocation in performance-critical code.
work_modes.acceptance: Hot path uses static, stack, or caller-provided buffers.
work_modes.falsification: malloc or GC-dependent hot path is required.

work_modes.title: Q16.16 numeric discipline
work_modes.purpose: Promote formulas without floating-point dependency.
work_modes.acceptance: Fixed vectors match expected Q16.16 output.
work_modes.falsification: Float is required for promoted hot path.

work_modes.title: Auditable branchless selection
work_modes.purpose: Use masks or conditional select only where understandable.
work_modes.acceptance: Branchless output matches readable reference.

work_modes.title: GCD traversal proof
work_modes.purpose: Guarantee toroidal traversal termination and coverage.
work_modes.acceptance: gcd(delta, modulus)=1 for traversal parameters.

work_modes.title: Risk matrix
work_modes.purpose: Record risk, impact, and mitigation.
work_modes.acceptance: Risk text exists for promoted module.

work_modes.title: Digital custody
work_modes.purpose: Hash inputs and artifacts before movement or promotion.
work_modes.acceptance: SHA-256 or CRC evidence exists.

work_modes.title: Smallest-block proof
work_modes.purpose: Validate mini modules before system assembly.
work_modes.acceptance: Isolated unit passes before integration.

work_modes.title: Assembly macro discipline
work_modes.purpose: Avoid unknown calls and preserve register contract.
work_modes.acceptance: Macros and register constraints are documented before .S changes.
work_modes.falsification: Unknown BL or x0..x4 violation appears.

work_modes.title: Metaphor separation
work_modes.purpose: Classify parables as teaching aids until tested.
work_modes.acceptance: Each metaphor maps to hypothesis, requirement, or limitation.
work_modes.rollback: Move claim back to conceptual reference.

work_modes.title: Low-friction command
work_modes.purpose: Prefer one reproducible command per validation target.
work_modes.acceptance: Command is present and stable.
work_modes.rollback: Document manual procedure until command exists.

work_modes.title: Navigation audit
work_modes.purpose: Ensure new artifacts are discoverable.
work_modes.acceptance: Indices reference new artifacts.
work_modes.failover: Use DOC_INDEX as source of truth.

work_modes.title: Federated locality
work_modes.purpose: Keep sensitive data inside the node.
work_modes.acceptance: Only aggregate or route tag leaves node.

work_modes.title: ARM compatibility ladder
work_modes.purpose: Keep AArch64 primary and ARM32 fallback visible.
work_modes.acceptance: ABI path is declared before native promotion.

work_modes.title: Cortex-A53 budget
work_modes.purpose: Protect low-memory devices from overhead.
work_modes.acceptance: Memory and cycle budget are stated.

work_modes.title: PASS FAIL SKIPPED honesty
work_modes.purpose: Make every check outcome explicit.
work_modes.acceptance: Final report lists pass, fail, and skipped checks.
work_modes.rollback: Do not merge until failure is explained.
work_modes.falsification: A failure is hidden or omitted.

work_modes.title: Two-cycle promotion
work_modes.purpose: Inventory and validation precede fullstack implementation.
work_modes.acceptance: Cycle A evidence exists before Cycle B.
work_modes.falsification: Fullstack code lands before inventory evidence.

work_modes.title: Real-use map
work_modes.purpose: Connect seed, user value, command, result, and risk.
work_modes.acceptance: Manifest validates at least 20 complete work modes.
work_modes.falsification: A seed has no user-facing result or validation route.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility
dimensions.evidence: Fixed input must produce fixed output hash; audit and unit tests must be repeatable.
dimensions.falsification: Same input produces different digest without documented cause.

dimensions.name: Deterministic safety
dimensions.evidence: All promoted paths define input, output, error, rollback and failover.
dimensions.falsification: A promoted route lacks rollback or failover.

dimensions.name: No-heap hot path
dimensions.evidence: Native and assembly promotions require fixed buffers or caller-provided memory.
dimensions.falsification: Hot path requires malloc, GC, or unbounded allocation.

dimensions.name: Fixed-point numeric discipline
dimensions.evidence: Q16.16 vectors are required before formula promotion.
dimensions.falsification: Promoted low-level numeric path depends on float.

dimensions.name: Branchless auditability
dimensions.evidence: Branchless optimization must match readable reference and remain explainable.

dimensions.name: Toroidal termination proof
dimensions.evidence: Traversal parameters must preserve gcd(delta, modulus)=1.
dimensions.falsification: GCD condition fails or loop bound is absent.

dimensions.name: Security custody
dimensions.evidence: CRC32C, SHA-256 or Merkle trail is required before artifact movement.

dimensions.name: Privacy locality
dimensions.evidence: Federated data keeps raw payload inside the node.
dimensions.falsification: Raw payload leaves node during federated route.

dimensions.name: Platform portability
dimensions.evidence: AArch64 primary and ARM32 fallback remain explicit before native promotion.

dimensions.name: Observability
dimensions.evidence: PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED and error class are reported for each validation.
dimensions.falsification: A failure is hidden or unclassified.

dimensions.name: Low-friction operations
dimensions.evidence: Every promoted claim has a single reproducible command or documented skipped reason.
dimensions.falsification: No command or skip reason exists.

dimensions.name: Semantic integrity
dimensions.evidence: Metaphors remain teaching aids until promoted by tests and falsification.
dimensions.falsification: Parable is presented as production evidence.
